reviews.title: Almost Broke My Device
reviews.text: This was AMAZING at first, but then I realised I had to pay. So I went ahead and bought the 1 month thing, as I just wanted to have it for a little while. I was lookin through the themes, when I decided to choose the next day. I went ahead and tried to close the tab, BUT IT NEVER WORKED!!  I tried to exit, ending up having to restart my phone. When I looked on it the next day,  nothing was working. I noticed lots of glitches, and then everything stopped. My screen froze, so I had to delete the app. NEVER DOING THIS AGAIN. This might not happen to other people, but for your safety, use it on a device you don't care about as much. I recommend themepack more.
